segments.en: It is impossible to draw close to the true Tzadik — except through nullifying oneself and one's honor and one's name before the honor of His kingship Yisburach — to the very ultimate nullification. And then one will merit to be included in the name of the Tzadik — who is able to bring him close to Hashem Yisburach and His Torah.
